source.rationale:
TWIN CONTRACT. dym-transform and dym-transform-partial are byte-identical apart from the `promotion` DOMAIN_PROBE entry (and two comment rules), so every behaviour that is not promotion-specific MUST hold identically on both. Ported deliberately rather than left to the twin: this repo has been bitten before by a fork asserted to be identical that had quietly drifted, and a rule proven on only one copy is a rule the other copy is free to lose. Same inputs, same expected output as dym-transform/HC-picker-option-without-a-code-is-not-an-exclusion.json — if the two ever disagree, one of these two fixtures fails.

Behaviour under test: A picker option carrying no code at all is skipped silently: it is neither an F-DUPE exclusion nor an unresolvable uuid. With every cause counting zero the skip reason must stay the generic `no_candidate_uuid` — the boundary that a '>= 0' mutation crosses, inventing a cross-company ambiguity that never happened.
